title: T.I. Hits 50 Cent With Another Bristling Diss Track: ‘I Don’t Make Memes’
summary: 50 has wiped his IG clean of all recent posts tied to T.I. and the Harris family.
contentText:
T.I. has released another fiery diss track targeting 50 Cent, and he doesn’t seem to have any intention of stopping anytime soon.

The latest bristling diss arrived on Wednesday night (Feb. 25) via a post on X , which features a photo of a scrawny 50 Cent from his role in 2011’s  All Things Fall Apart as the cover art.

“Msg to da D—o dealer: I don’t make memes I MAKE MUSIC!!!! IDGAF what you erase… You keep posting = it’s Problems!!!! #WhatBully,” Tip captioned the post for what appears to be titled “What Bully.”

In the lyrics, T.I. calls out 50 for being the bully of hip-hop on social media, but when the tables turned, the G-Unit mogul tucked his tail and wanted no part of sparring with the trap pioneer in the booth. “You da kinda sucka n—a we don’t like/ Want to bully everybody who don’t want no problem/ Then n—as come bully you and you don’t want no problem,” T.I. raps to close out the track.

Msg to da Dildo dealer: I don't make memes I MAKE MUSIC!!!! IDGAF what you erase… You keep posting = it's Problems!!!! #WhatBully 🦆 pic.twitter.com/ES7W2i16pO

— T.I. (@Tip) February 26, 2026

50 has refused to respond to Tip with raps, but has continued to reply with various memes and posts to social media. “Goes to old rappers stil trying to battle rap, ChatGPT told me that. I don’t need to rap, YOU need me to rap. LOL get the fvck off my page,” 50 replied in his caption of a since-deleted post with a “Stupid A— N—a Award” diploma photo.

However, 50 has since backed down and scrubbed his entire IG feed of all his previous posts tied to T.I. and his family members, such as Tip’s wife (Tiny Harris) and son King Harris.

“I’m out of here, you guys hurt my feelings,” 50 wrote alongside a photo of him heading on a private jet.

T.I. has basked in the buzz while poking at 50, as their relationship deteriorated since the Queens native backed down from a potential Verzuz battle.

As he preps his final Kill the King album, Tip’s momentum has carried him back to the Billboard Hot 100 , where his “Let ‘Em Know” hit has reached a peak of No. 43 on the chart dated Feb. 28.
